about.title: Who is Mohamed?
about.p1: I'm Mohamed Rashad, and I build the parts you don't see. An interface you can see. A backend you can trust. And a system ready to scale with the project.
about.p2: Full Stack Web Developer with over 4 years of web development experience, specializing in Laravel and React.js. Focused on building fast, secure, and scalable applications, from database architecture and APIs to user interfaces and UX.
about.p3: Studying Artificial Intelligence at Elsewedy University of Technology (SUT) following my graduation from Elsewedy School where I studied 3 years of software engineering under the British Pearson BTECs curriculum. Throughout my journey, I have built production solutions across E-commerce, LMS, ERP, Medical Systems, Multi-Vendor, and Multi-Tenancy.
about.p4: Among my key projects is Tabiiba, a comprehensive healthcare and appointment booking platform connecting patients with doctors, clinics, and medical centers, where I built scheduling engines, clinics & branches, access control, notifications, and analytics dashboards.
about.p5: I also engineered WizFreelance, an official corporate portal with an all-in-one management dashboard overseeing client project requests, sales, freelance operations, content, and SEO, alongside developing Multi-Vendor and Multi-Tenancy systems serving multiple businesses with strict tenant and data isolation.
about.p6: Committed to Clean Code, Performance, Scalability, Security, and RESTful APIs, with extensive remote work experience with clients and enterprises in Egypt and Saudi Arabia.
